column3: They got us this time.\nNext time they'll pay.\nI swear it.{end_wait}
We fled here from the\neruption of Mt. Aleph.{end_wait}
Tell me the truth.\nDid Alchemy cause the\neruption on Mt. Aleph?{end_wait}

That tree was a man. He
came to us already cursed.{page_break}His last words were that
he had wronged the sacred
tree.{end_wait}
You missed the tree?\nLook around some more.{end_wait}

Yes, I had the tree cut
down for my palace!{page_break}And if anyone is a
victim here, it's me!
I've waited months for it!{end_wait}
A tree spirit's curse?\nFoolish old superstition!{page_break}All I want is to live\nin a big palace!{end_wait}
I've lost count of the men\nLord McCoy has hired.{page_break}Not one has come back.{end_wait}
You don't look strong.\nMaybe that's for the best.{end_wait}
No. I saw it. That flow\nof force came from you.{end_wait}
I knew it. I saw a ghostly\nforce pushing that statue.{end_wait}
Psynergy? Is that what\nyou call it?{end_wait}
It's a gift of the\nMercury Clan, passed down\nthrough our blood.{end_wait}
We call it Ply. It is\ndrawn through meditation.{end_wait}
Whoever entered the\nlighthouse will answer\nto me.{end_wait}
You're going farther\ninto the lighthouse,\naren't you?{end_now}
Don't tell me it's nothing.\nYou didn't come this far\nby accident.{end_wait}
You've got your reasons.\nI have mine.{end_wait}
Are you going on, or not?{end_now}
Someone's inside.\nI'm not turning back.\nAre you coming?{end_now}
Someone got inside.\nI'm going to find out why.{end_wait}
My family guarded this\nlighthouse for generations.\nI won't abandon it.{end_wait}
I'm going with you.\nI know this place.\nYou'll need my help.{end_wait}
So the children\nsurvived Mt. Aleph.{end_wait}
You came this far\nfor {actor_name:6} and Kraden?{end_wait}
